title: betula gmelinii var. zyzyphifolia
intro: Betula gmelinii var. zyzyphifolia, commonly known as Korean birch, is a plant species within the Betulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean birch include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Korean birch, including betulinic acid and betulin, have been shown to have anti-cancer, anti-viral, and anti-inflammatory effects.
